content:
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT: GPU health alerts firing for pool-gpu-2 - multiple streams: thermal spike, ECC corrected bursts, VRAM pressure. Paging oncall for eng-sre. https://internal.incident/1870001234 :rotating_light:
Izzy: acked, I'm on it. pulling telemetry now.
Izzy: quick check - thermal across node-gpu-12 jumped to 86C around 03:12 UTC, VRAM usage steady ~92% on a few pods. ECC corrected count spiked on gpu-12 and gpu-14.
Devon: seeing same on metrics - `nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes` high for serving-prod shards. latency +15% on model-embedder route. no 5xxs reported yet.
Tara: tagging as P1? any customer-facing errors?
Izzy: not yet P1. routing fallbacks are healthy, but latency increase could impact tail-SLO for some customers on Dedicated clusters. I want to page platform owners if ECC keeps spiking.
Matt: can we drain hot node if it keeps overheating? prefer to avoid until we confirm ECC trend.
OpsBot: automated note: created incident task INC-187000 (owner: izzy).
Izzy: digging logs, posting quick snapshot: ```
[03:10:41] gpu-12 ECC corrected: +7
[03:11:02] gpu-14 ECC corrected: +5
[03:12:03] gpu-12 temp: 86.1 C
[03:12:15] gpu-12 vram_used: 12.2 GiB / 13 GiB (93%)
```
Devon: hunch: job-level memory leak or scheduling spike -> VRAM contention -> thermal from sustained load. Could be a rollout? checking deploys.
Izzy: deploy history: no deploys in the last hour for serving-prod. there was a scheduled batch job on dedicated-batch-3 that coincides.
Tara: ok operational plan: 1) suppress noisy ECC alerting (we're getting bursts but not a failure) 2) add short-term metric dashboard tile for ECC delta and VRAM headroom 3) if ECC corrected > 10 in 10m on same GPU, escalate and cordon the node 4) create post-incident task to investigate job causing VRAM pressure.
Matt: +1. suggest adjusting alert sensitivity rather than full mute. change rule to require sustained increase.
Izzy: proposed quick Prometheus alert patch (will apply to staging then prod): ```yaml
alert: GPU_ECC_Burst
expr: increase(nvidia_gpu_ecc_corrected_total[5m]) > 3
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "GPU ECC corrected error burst on {{ $labels.instance }}"
```
Izzy: current prod rule was firing on `increase(...[1m]) > 0` which is too chatty during transient spikes.
Devon: also propose VRAM pressure alert: ```yaml
alert: GPU_VRAM_High
expr: (nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes / nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes) > 0.9
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warn
```
Tara: create dashboard panel for 1m/5m ECC delta + 95th latency overlay. put it on the incident dashboard so platform owners can eyeball.
Izzy: muting noisy channel alerts for next 30m while we tune. will post progress. :mute:
Oncall Bot: Alert suppression enabled for rule GPU_ECC_Burst (30m) by Izzy.
Matt: I started a kdump-style capture job for gpu-12 to collect nvml counters, leaving at low priority.
Devon: customer note: reached out to SEs for clusters seeing tail latency. no active customer tickets yet. logging update to INC-187000.
Izzy: running `kubectl top` shows pods pinned to gpu-12: `embedder-v3-7f8b`, `reranker-1-cc4d`, `batch-transform-2` - batch-transform looks heavy.
Tara: can we evict batch-transform from dedicated serving pool to batch pool? Migration quick win if it reduces VRAM.
Izzy: attempted soft-evict via scale-down of replicas on node-12; one batch pod rescheduled to batch-pool-1 successfully. VRAM usage on gpu-12 dropped to 78% in 3 minutes.
Devon: nice. ECC corrected deltas also dropping.
Oncall Bot: update: automated paging cleared for rule GPU_ECC_Burst - no new pageers in last 15m.
Izzy: monitoring for 15 more minutes then re-enable fuller alerting with new thresholds.
Tara: action items captured in INC-187000: [1] update ECC alert rule to 5m->10m window and threshold, [2] add VRAM headroom alert and dashboard tile, [3] add node auto-cordon policy when sustained ECC or thermal above threshold, [4] run RCA for batch job memory behavior. assign owners.
Matt: also recommend postmortem to verify cooling/thermal profile for gpu-12, check driver firmware and ECC historicals.
Izzy: short customer impact blurb for ops: "No errors observed, transient latency increase ~15% on specific Dedicated shard; mitigation (evict batch job) reduced VRAM and thermals. No remediation required for customer-facing infra at this time."
Devon: logging that to INC-187000.notes, will ping CS to keep them in the loop.
Tara: I'm taking the handoff for long-running tasks. Izzy, leave any remaining runbooks or commands in the incident ticket. I'll follow up with platform owners tomorrow to bake the alert tuning into alerting repo.
Izzy: handoff ack. leaving alerts suppressed until 1870001434, will re-evaluate then.
Oncall Bot: Handoff recorded: owner -> Tara, followup ETA 24h.
Tara: final: create follow-up dashboard PR and add alert review in next SRE weekly. closing active paging loop for now. :white_check_mark:
